title: RAVA Digital Atelier — Luminous spatial studio
prompt: A product-centered Persian RTL RAVA TEAM homepage on a luminous pearl studio surface. A responsive page canvas visibly transforms from wireframe to finished site, surrounded only by purposeful content, mobile-preview and release layers. Use a floating refractive 3D glass Navbar, partially open Platform mega menu, compact tactile controls, Estedad/Vazirmatn-like Persian type, deep navy and controlled cobalt. Exclude buildings, fake proof, generic cards, flat oversized buttons and decorative objects.
